integrity: The projector, reflection, pre-identification recurrence, fixed point, affine-cell matrix, invariant-ball argument, and exact contraction factor were derived explicitly.

The primary Demanet--Zhang full text was inspected at the algorithm, transient-regime, and eventual-rate passages; the Liang--Fadili--Peyre--Luke full text was inspected at the finite-identification theorem.
The embedded checker replays the original nonlinear iteration and verifies representative cases; the proof, not finite testing, establishes the parameter continuum.
No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The exact onset formula is proved for the two-variable family with \(0<a<1\), \(b>0\), zero initialization, and the Demanet--Zhang ordering of standard Douglas--Rachford.
The condition \(\gamma\ge b/(1-a)\) is sufficient for permanent cell invariance but is not claimed necessary.
The exact norm law concerns the auxiliary Douglas--Rachford iterate after identification; no identical law is claimed for every shadow observable.
A later or differently phrased analysis may contain the same two-variable delay law.
title: Exact threshold-controlled transient before Douglas--Rachford linear convergence in two-variable basis pursuit
